info.title: NECO MCS Voting API
info.description: High-Performance Electronic Accreditation & Voting System API for NECO MCS Election

post.description:
Validate 4-digit MCS number. If user exists and is active, returns
voter's full name to be displayed in an uneditable field for confirmation.

Accepts phone and email (both compulsory), generates OTP,
and sends it to the user's email with header 'NECO MCS Accreditation'.
Phone and email are NOT saved to the user table until OTP is verified.

Verifies the accreditation OTP. Only after OTP validation are the
user's phone and email fields populated and is_accredited set to True.

On election day, voter enters their 4-digit MCS username and clicks validate.
Verifies eligibility, checks active election status, and sends a 6-digit OTP
to their registered email with header 'NECO MCS Voting'.

On election day, voter enters their 4-digit MCS username and clicks validate.
Verifies eligibility, checks active election status, and sends a 6-digit OTP
to their registered email with header 'NECO MCS Voting'.

Accepts username + OTP code.
If valid and not expired, returns a JWT access token.

Admin and super-admin login using username + password.
OTP is NOT required for admin roles.

get.description:
Returns complete breakdown of:
all voters, all accredited voters, unaccredited voters, eligible & non-eligible voters,
active & disabled voters, and total votes cast with turnout percentage.
Download a CSV file containing all voters and their accreditation/eligibility statuses.
Download a professional PDF document containing all voters and their statuses.

patch.description:
Disable or enable an individual voter. Any voter disabled by admin
becomes a non-eligible voter and cannot log in to vote or accredit.

get.description:
Returns only the authenticated voter's cast votes and receipts.
Ensures voters cannot view other voters' ballots.

Cached for high concurrency.

post.description: Start voting immediately. Only when voting is started can voters log in and vote.
Stop voting immediately. When clicked, voting stops immediately; no one can vote anymore.
